description: This is a Go source file implementing WebRTC client functionality for a frontend component, including peer connection management, signaling, ICE candidate handling, and data channel interaction.

classes.name: Signaling
classes.description: Contains channels and ICE server configurations for WebRTC signaling.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Manages the WebRTC peer connection lifecycle, signaling, and ICE candidates.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Interface for handling peer connection events such as data channels, errors, and connection status changes.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Represents a WebRTC connection with associated signaling and peer connection control.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes WebRTC connection, sets up event handlers, and handles signaling.

methods.name: recvLoop
methods.description: Processes incoming signaling messages and triggers appropriate actions.

methods.name: stopGoRoutines
methods.description: Stops signaling goroutines and cleans up resources.

methods.name: closeSendCh
methods.description: Closes the signaling send channel safely.

methods.name: sendSigMsg
methods.description: Sends signaling messages through the channel.

methods.name: onOffer
methods.description: Handles remote offer, creates answer, and updates peer connection.

methods.name: onAnswer
methods.description: Handles remote answer and updates peer connection.

methods.name: onICECandidate
methods.description: Adds remote ICE candidates to the peer connection.

methods.name: sendICECandidate
methods.description: Sends local ICE candidates via signaling.

methods.name: NewConnection
methods.description: Creates a new WebRTC connection using signaling and observer.

methods.name: NewConnectionWithLogger
methods.description: Creates a new WebRTC connection with custom logger configuration.
